name: WILLOW
recent: 公司于2026年10月19日召开特别股东大会，股东通过了两项资产出售议案及公司更名议案。公司名称将于2026年11月6日起由Willowglen MSC Berhad更改为Willownex Berhad。此外，公司延长了资产出售协议的最后截止日期。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上批准以RM40.0 million现金出售Willowglen (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. 100%股权。
股东批准以RM175.2 million出售Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd. 100%股权，其中RM72.0 million为现金，RM103.2 million通过发行Elixir II新股支付。
股东批准公司名称由Willowglen MSC Berhad更改为Willownex Berhad，自2026年11月6日起生效。

news.title: Willowglen MSC to be renamed Willownex Bhd from Nov 6

recent_en: The company held an EGM on 19 October 2026 where shareholders approved two asset disposal resolutions and a change of company name. The company name will change from Willowglen MSC Berhad to Willownex Berhad effective 6 November 2026. The company also extended the long stop date for the disposal agreements.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the disposal of 100% equity interest in Willowglen (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. to Elixir II Pte. Ltd. for RM40.0 million cash.
Shareholders approved the disposal of 100% equity interest in Willowglen Services Pte. Ltd. for RM175.2 million, satisfied via RM72.0 million cash and RM103.2 million in new Elixir II shares.
Shareholders approved the change of company name from Willowglen MSC Berhad to Willownex Berhad, effective 6 November 2026.
